tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background (Porcelain). In the dark theme, Ink: used for dark bands such as the hero, footer and feature sections.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, forms, menus and the price table.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Alternate section background (Stone). Use to separate consecutive sections instead of borders.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card borders. Decorative only; never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and checkbox borders. Passes 3:1 against surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on every surface. 15.7:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, credentials, metadata. 5.7:1 on surface (light), 8.6:1 (dark).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Evergreen. Primary buttons, links, active nav, the emblem. As text, on surface, surface-raised and brand-soft.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand fills.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill (primary button label). Never use ink-muted here.

tokens.name: brand-500
tokens.usage: Icons and large decorative accents. As text only at 24px+ or on surface (4.8:1).

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Mist. Icon wells, selected rows, brand badges (with brand text).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brass (light) / Champagne (dark). Eyebrows and small details only; never a button or large fill.

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Champagne as a small fill: the Primary tag in the logo guide, rule accents on Ink. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmation text and icons.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons, e.g. price may change.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning notices.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Form errors and destructive states.

tokens.name: error-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error notices.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational notices.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of info notices.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px, offset 2px from the element.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind text on photos and behind dialogs. Minimum 55% Ink.

tokens.name: raw-ink
tokens.usage: Raw brand colour, identical in both themes. For the logo, fixed-colour bands, print and illustration; UI uses the semantic tokens above.

tokens.name: raw-evergreen
tokens.usage: Raw brand colour, identical in both themes. For the logo, fixed-colour bands, print and illustration; UI uses the semantic tokens above.

tokens.name: raw-sage
tokens.usage: Raw brand colour, identical in both themes. For the logo, fixed-colour bands, print and illustration; UI uses the semantic tokens above.

tokens.name: raw-mist
tokens.usage: Raw brand colour, identical in both themes. For the logo, fixed-colour bands, print and illustration; UI uses the semantic tokens above.

tokens.name: raw-porcelain
tokens.usage: Raw brand colour, identical in both themes. For the logo, fixed-colour bands, print and illustration; UI uses the semantic tokens above.

tokens.name: raw-champagne
tokens.usage: Raw brand colour, identical in both themes. For the logo, fixed-colour bands, print and illustration; UI uses the semantic tokens above.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero headline only, once per page. Mobile: 42/46.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Card titles, doctor names. Mobile: 20/26. Smallest size for Bricolage.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a page or section title. Mobile: 18/28.
styles.sample: An implant replaces the root of a missing tooth.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text. Max 68 characters per line. Never smaller on mobile.
styles.sample: The teeth on either side are not drilled or reshaped.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body, table row labels.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase section kicker in accent colour. Always paired with a heading.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: Prices and times in tables; enable tabular figures.

spacing.note: 4px base. Section rhythm: space-9 desktop, space-8 mobile.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside compact elements.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related inline items (badges, icon + text).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Label to input; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter; gap inside cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding (mobile); grid gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding (desktop); gap between heading block and content.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding (mobile).

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Section padding (desktop).

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Hero padding (desktop).

radius.note: Three radii plus pill. Nothing else.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small tags, table cells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, notices, images inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Feature images and large panels. The arch frame is radius-pill on the top corners + radius-lg at the bottom.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, badges, chips.

shadow.note: Mostly flat. Elevation only for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Resting cards on sunken backgrounds.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, sticky header after scroll, dropdowns.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the mobile menu sheet.

tokens.name: container-text
tokens.usage: Articles, service body copy, forms.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Standard page content width.

tokens.name: container-wide
tokens.usage: Hero and full-bleed image grids.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablet breakpoint: two-column grids start.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Desktop breakpoint: full nav shows.

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of any tappable element.
